subject: Avery Lin — interview day itinerary & concierge notes
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara@talentbridge.io>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example, lauren_bishop@redwood.example, irene_choi@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Avery Lin — proposed interview day (Tue 5/28)

Hi Dylan / Lauren / Irene,

Hope you’re all well. Per our conversation, Avery Lin is available for a full-day on Tuesday 5/28 (PDT). Quick candidate snapshot: ex-frontend at Nimbus Health, strong systems design + user-facing latency work, portfolio link included in the resume.

Proposed blocks (all PDT):
- 10:00–10:40 — Product + PM (30–40 min)
- 11:00–11:40 — Frontend system design (40 min)
- 12:00–12:30 — Lunch buffer / accessibility break
- 13:00–13:40 — Live coding (pairing)
- 15:00–15:30 — Team cultural + wrap

Avery’s contact: avery.lin@example.com
Resume attached: Avery_Lin_Resume.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

Let me know if those times work or if you want the frontload/ backload changed. Candidate prefers remote; they noted one accommodation request in principle (see below) and asked to coordinate materials ahead of time.

Accommodation note from candidate (raw): "I use a screen reader on my laptop and I do better when interview prompts and diagrams are provided in simple HTML or plain text before the session — large images can break my flow."

If confirmed, I’ll send the calendar and pass on any logistics from the candidate.

Best,
Sara Holt
Talent Partner, TalentBridge
[sara@talentbridge.io]

--
Attachment: Avery_Lin_Resume.pdf

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.example
To: Avery Lin <avery.lin@example.com>, Sara Holt <sara@talentbridge.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, irene_choi@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Avery Lin — proposed interview day (Tue 5/28)

Thanks Sara — that schedule works for us.

Avery — great to meet you over email. We’ll run the day remotely on Tue 5/28 (PDT). Below is the working itinerary and logistics; I’ll post a calendar invite with Zoom + dial-in shortly.

Zoom meeting (master): https://zoom.us/j/999-888-7777 (passcode: Redwood2027)
Dial-in (US): +1 415 555 0123 (Meeting ID: 999 888 7777)
Master agenda (times PDT):
- 10:00 — Introductions (10m) + Product / PM (30m)
- 11:00 — Frontend system design (40m) — prompts will be provided as plain-text and a minimal diagram link in Drive
- 12:00 — 1:1 break / lunch buffer (30m) — feel free to step away
- 13:00 — Live coding (pair) (40m) — we will share a plain-text prompt in the chat and a small starter repo link
- 15:00 — Team + wrap (30m)

Accommodation options we can provide today:
- Pre-publish interview prompts as plain text and also provide a high-contrast PDF
- 10-minute padding between rounds (we’ll build a 10–15 min buffer in schedule)
- Audio-only dial-in available if you prefer the phone instead of Zoom video

Avery, please tell us the exact format you prefer (screen-reader friendly doc, email, Drive link with plain text) and any pronoun preference we should use in introductions.

Lauren / Irene — I’m copying you to confirm panel assignments below, and I’ll upload the panel brief and eval form to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e-avery-prep

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Dylan Brooks
Senior Recruiter (Technical Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Avery Lin — proposed interview day (Tue 5/28)

Thanks — that itinerary looks good. A few notes on my side:

1) Materials: Please provide prompts and any diagrams as plain text or very simple HTML in the Drive folder. PDFs are okay if they are tagged / screen-reader friendly.
2) Breaks: I appreciate the lunch buffer — could we add a 10-minute buffer between the 11:00 and 13:00 sessions (so I have time to reset)?
3) Backup option: If Zoom video fails, I’ll join by audio-only dial-in.
4) Pronouns: She/they — please use whichever feels natural.

I’m happy to do the full-day schedule as proposed. Attached is a short note with my accessibility preferences (I’ll also upload it to the Drive folder).

Best,
Avery

--
Note: candidate uploaded 'accessibility-preferences.txt' to the shared Drive folder.

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.example, irene_choi@redwood.example, Avery Lin <avery.lin@example.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Avery Lin — interview day (Tue 5/28)

Thanks all — confirmed on our side. I’ve attached the panel brief and the interviewer evaluation sheet to this thread and the Drive folder. Quick notes for the interviewers (please read before your session):

- Panel assignments:
  - Product / PM (10:00): Irene Choi — focus on prioritization + tradeoffs
  - Frontend system design (11:00): Lauren Bishop — focus on scaling, observability
  - Live coding / pairing (13:00): Justin Park (external contractor) — we’ll use the private pair room on Codeshare
  - Team + wrap (15:00): Dylan Brooks + Team

- Interview prep: Share plain-text prompts in chat 5 minutes before the start of the round. Where a diagram is needed, post a link to a minimal SVG in the Drive folder rather than embedding large images.
- Accessibility: Please mute notifications and keep camera views stable if video is used — small motion or auto-playing backgrounds can interfere with screen readers.
- Evaluation: Use the attached 'interviewer-eval.xlsx' and leave a bullet summary in column C for quick sync.

Panel brief attached: panel-brief-avery-lin.pdf (contains prompts and suggested question variants).

If anyone needs to swap out of a slot, flag me and I’ll coordinate coverage.

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Frontend
Redwood Inference

- Candidate pacing: handled follow-ups well, asked clarifying questions during system design — +
- Live coding: completed the core task and explained tradeoffs — +/
- Culture fit: engaged with team, asked concrete product questions — +

- Lauren to consolidate interview notes in interviewer-eval.xlsx and leave a 1-line recommendation in column C by EOD tomorrow.
- I’ll schedule a hiring committee readout once we have the consolidated evals.

Avery, thanks again for accommodating our schedule and for sharing your accessibility preferences — that made the day run cleaner for everyone.
